title: Bill To is on for every shop at release with no setting to switch
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the production test account.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, that bills itself.
  • Make sure no setting was changed for Bill To on the production test account.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".
  • No setting had to be switched on to see it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
